note: Research could not be completed: no public record of this entity was retrievable. The primary search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the entire session ('Connection refused'), and fallbacks failed — Google returned HTTP 429, ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo HTML/lite timed out, and Bing silently ignored the quoted phrase and returned only generic 'house' results (Wikipedia 'House' TV series, house.gov, Zillow), i.e. zero matches for the company name. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page loaded but is a JavaScript form that cannot be queried via plain GET, so no SDN/Non-SDN screening result was obtained. No claim here should be read as a negative clearance. Note also that the name is an OPC (One Person Company) — a small single-member entity that typically has no credit rating and minimal public litigation footprint, which is consistent with the absence of hits but does not prove it. Recommended follow-up when tools are restored: (1) MCA master data / ZaubaCorp / Tofler lookup for the exact registered name and status; (2) OFAC, UN Consolidated, EU consolidated and UK OFSI lists by exact name; (3) BIS Entity List and India DGFT denied-entity list; (4) eCourts/NCLT by company name and by director name; (5) GST/import-export (DGFT IEC) records for any Russia/CIS counterparties.
